name: Ridge Lines
description: Bright bowed pads and keys drawn from three rows of hills that slide behind one another, so that overtones glide in and out of view while the pitch stands still.

params.name: Near
params.description: The row in front, which carries the note. Hills are round and ring on, Pines nasal and dry, Cliffs bright like a bowed string, Towers hollow and long.

params.name: Far
params.description: The two rows behind, which show over the front one. Hills glide, Pines flicker high up and wide, Cliffs climb and drop so that every note swells with them.

params.name: Repeats
params.description: How often the middle row repeats in one cycle of the note, with the last row a few more. It places the overtones that glide: low ones are broad, high ones whistle.

params.name: Height
params.description: How far the rows behind rise over the one in front. Low they show only in its gaps, high they cover it and their overtones lead.

params.name: Travel
params.description: How fast the rows behind slide past. At zero the picture stands still, in the middle it glides slowly, at the top the overtones flutter.

params.name: Parallax
params.description: How differently the two rows behind move. At zero they slide as one. Further up the last row lags, stops, then turns back, and it stands higher in the overtones.

params.name: Penumbra
params.description: How soft the edge is where one row covers another. Low cuts sharp corners that sparkle, high lets the rows shine through each other.

params.name: Sun
params.description: How low the sun stands. Each outline throws its shadow along itself: a short one brightens the tone, a long one hollows it like a reed.

params.name: Jag
params.description: Rough rock on every row. It adds a fine grain of high overtones that glitters as the rows move.

params.name: Two Eyes
params.description: How far apart the two eyes stand. Left and right see the rows behind at different places while the fundamental stays in the middle.

params.name: Ground
params.description: How strong the fundamental is, which stands still under all that moves. At zero only overtones are left.

params.name: Tone
params.description: How far the upper overtones reach. A hard touch opens it further.

params.name: Glow
params.description: How much the brightness follows the level of each note, so it opens as a note rises and closes as it fades.

params.name: Body
params.description: The wooden box the sound stands in. It lifts some fixed bands and sinks others, so every key has a grain of its own.

params.name: Wind
params.description: Air carried by the tone, like a bow's hair on a string. It moves with every cycle and bites a little at the start of a note.

params.name: Company
params.description: Two more players beside the first, each tuned a little away. Low is a gentle widening, high is a whole section.

params.name: Vibrato
params.description: Depth of the waver in pitch and loudness, which rocks the rows as well. It comes in a moment after a note starts.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a note takes to rise. Short is struck or plucked, long is a slow swell.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long a note takes to fall from its peak to where Sustain holds it. Hills and Towers in front stretch it, Pines cut it short.

params.name: Sustain
params.description: The level a held note settles at. At zero each note dies away like a plucked string.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade after the key is let go. Hills and Towers in front stretch it, Pines cut it short.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The wave of each note is the outline of three rows seen one behind another: a smooth maximum of three periodic profiles, drawn every few milliseconds, taken through a transform where its band is limited and its fundamental is fixed, and read as a table. The profiles and the body are voiced by measurement and are not taken from any instrument or recording.
